title: Panigorr's Oven Arena
description: Enter the burning pits... fight and burn in the oven's flames!
canvas_arena_overview_description: In this place, souls burn and fight in the eternal flames. Each match brings you closer to the master's oven.

canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.duelo: A single burning duel. Two souls colliding in flames. The result is written in the ash.
canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.coliseo: Multiple souls in burning chaos. Minimum four. The last one standing wins the ashes.
canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.torneo: Structured burning tournament. Minimum eight. Brackets like the paths to the oven.

duelo.title: The Burning Duel
duelo.description: Challenge another soul to burn together. The result is written in the oven's records.
duelo.select_opponent: Select the soul you wish to burn with:
duelo.challenge_sent: The invitation has been sent into the flames. Awaiting the response from the ashes.
duelo.challenge_received_title: 🔥 YOU HAVE RECEIVED A BURNING CHALLENGE
duelo.challenge_received_desc: has challenged you to burn in the Arena.
duelo.declined: The challenge has been rejected into the flames. Some souls are not destined to burn.
duelo.no_weapons: You have no burning instruments yet. Participate in the flames to unlock them.

coliseo.title: The Burning Coliseum
coliseo.description: Minimum four burning souls. The last one wins one experience point from the ashes.
coliseo.not_enough: Insufficient burning souls. Four are required for the flames.
coliseo.scheduled: Coliseum scheduled in the oven. Entry open.
coliseo.cancelled: The burning has been cancelled. Not all souls found their way to the flames.

torneo.title: The Burning Tournament
torneo.description: Minimum eight burning souls. Elimination brackets. One experience point for the final soul.
torneo.not_enough: Insufficient burning souls. Eight are necessary for the brackets.
torneo.scheduled: Tournament scheduled in the oven. Entry open.
torneo.cancelled: The tournament has been cancelled. Some burnings do not find their beginning.

ranking.title: Burning Souls Ranking
ranking.no_fighters: No burning souls registered yet. The oven awaits its first ash.
